posts.title: Notes on Rach Gia – old town remnants, provincial merger, land reclamation, and future artificial islands
posts.description: Rach Gia is the capital of An Giang province in the Mekong Delta region of Vietnam. The port serves ferries to Phu Quoc and the Nam Du archipelago, which is how I ended up staying here twice in one week. My itinerary was Phu Quoc – Rach Gia – Hon Son – Rach Gia – […]
